biotools.summary: JoGo is a haplotype database covering 4.7 million haplotypes across 19,194 human genes. It provides a novel hierarchical nomenclature and enables search by gene, variant, or haplotype, with functionalities including ClinVar and GWAS data integration, and privacy-preserving local viewer options.
